text:
Type: sofa with chaise longue
Use: seating, lounging with legs up; living room, family room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: textured fabric upholstery, dark stained wood legs and base frame
Colors: off-white, warm cream, dark brown wood
Shape: straight track arms, tall straight back with three cushions, deep chaise on the right, slim dark legs with a sled-like base, clean lines
Feel: calm, bright, refined
Goes with: light oak, black accents, wool and linen textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or modern living rooms

product.name: NOCKEBY
product.type_ikea: Two-seat sofa w chaise longue right
product.description: You get extra soft comfort and support because the thick seat cushions have a core of pocket springs and a top of cut foam and polyester fibres.
